Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1. What's the Best Broadband in Singapore?

The best plan depends on your household's data demands. For smart homes, multi-device 4K streaming, and concurrent working from home, a 5Gbps plan offers ample bandwidth. For households with intensive needs such as hardcore gaming, content creators uploading large files, or numerous active devices running simultaneously, a 10Gbps plan provides the necessary capacity to ensure seamless performance for everyone.


2. What's the difference between 10Gbps and 5Gbps Broadband?

The main difference is speed and capacity. With 10Gbps broadband, you get double the bandwidth of a 5Gbps connection. That means lightning-fast downloads, ultra-low latency gaming, and maximum performance for the heavy data demands of modern, multi-device households.


3. Do I need a Wi-Fi 6 or Wi-Fi 7 Router?

Wi-Fi 6 offers excellent speed, latency, and efficiency. But for those who want to get the absolute most out of their ultra-fast broadband plans, Wi-Fi 7 takes it a step further, delivering future-ready performance and capacity.

4. Can I pair my broadband plan with other StarHub services for extra savings?

Yes. Through StarHub Hubbing, you can pair your 5Gbps or 10Gbps UltraSpeed broadband plan with our 5G Unlimited+ mobile plans at 20% off!

5. Will I get help with my Broadband Set-up?

Leave it to the experts! Our Hub Troopers have got your broadband setup handled.

When you upgrade or sign up, our Hub Troopers will handle everything end-to-end:

  • Consultation: Assess your home layout and usage needs to determine your ideal setup.
  • Advise: Recommend the best locations for your router(s) and the number of units for optimal WiFi coverage.
  • Test: Perform a WiFi test to ensure you're all set for the best broadband experience possible.
